component.name: LayerC
component.summary: Passive X11 overlay with a profile editor

description.p: LayerC runs passive, click-through cooldown, timer, counter and indicator panels on X11. The LayerE editor creates and edits profiles, cooldowns, bindings and ordered panel items, saves them durably and asks the running daemon to reload them. Command-line tools cover profile and bundle management, runtime control and visual calibration.
LayerC never injects input, reads game memory or needs elevated privileges. Native Wayland sessions are not supported.
Adds typed panel items, cooldown active duration and timer presets in both editors. The Wayland backend remains an unqualified preview.
LayerC 2.6.2 (release label v2.6c) adds the LayerE profile editor for X11, packaged with the daemon and tools.
